title: The 'name it (it stands down)' peaceful option on the honour guard at The Old Crypts reported 'You speak its true name, and it remembers what it was' but the way remained locked and a follow-up 'speak the old rest-rite' check failed and the guard attacked anyway — the 'stood down' status text was misleading since combat still triggered.
